documentation.rationale: The service list is specific by mileage but bare: no receipts, no dates, no VIN, no title or history report. Neither the identity/terms half nor the maintenance-evidence half is established.

condition.rationale: Photos show clean black paint, a tidy grey leather interior with normal bolster creasing, matching all-terrain tires and a level stance. Headlight lenses are visibly yellowed. Underside, dash, cluster and engine bay are not examined here. Claimed work is unproven.

price_value.rationale: The $14,000 ask sits essentially at the fair-value mid of $13,837. The comparable San Jose 2008 sold at $15,000 with 176k miles. The mods add little resale value, and the yellowed headlights are minor known work.

mission_fit.rationale: Body-on-frame V8 4WD, a mild quality lift, all-terrain tires and a roof basket give capability the RX lacks. That suits light camping, though the basket is not a dedicated rooftop-tent mount. 198.5k miles is acceptable on a Lexus if the belt and air-suspension questions are answered.

logistics.rationale: Corona, CA is roughly 330 miles away. A Southern California private sale is easy to register in CA, but PPI access is not stated. A fly-and-drive trip is straightforward if a local Toyota/Lexus shop can inspect first.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: Black over grey with a tasteful, coherent mild build: Eibach lift, Method wheels, BFGs. It is a typical base GX otherwise, and the build is not worth a premium.

Check the radiator, hoses and cooling system for leaks; pressure test
Inspect the lift install: rear coil conversion versus air bags, height-control system, CV angles, upper/lower ball joints, alignment
Inspect frame rails, rear crossmember and spare-tire area for rust or trail damage on a lifted car
Check transmission and transfer-case fluid condition; test 4WD/center-diff lock and low range
Full OBD and chassis scan for stored codes, including secondary air injection and VSC/suspension codes
Listen for an exhaust manifold tick at cold start and check for manifold cracks
Inspect the new steering rack and power-steering pump for leaks, plus inner/outer tie rods
Check tire date codes and the full-size spare
Check the dash for cracks and look for evidence of accident repair (panel gaps, overspray)
what_would_change_verdict: Up: invoices for the 179k timing-belt/water-pump/radiator job, a clean title/history report, and documented coil conversion or healthy rear air.
Up: a clean PPI with a dry underside, no codes and correct 4WD function.
Down: a branded title, accident damage, frame rust or trail damage underneath.
Down: a failed or bypassed rear air system with suspension lights, or no proof of the timing belt at all.
Down: the seller declines the VIN or a PPI.
evidence.mission_note: A lifted, all-terrain-shod body-on-frame V8 GX with a roof basket supplies camping and trail capability the RX 350 does not, so it fits the utility_capability branch. Accelerated_bridge mode still requires the VIN, receipts and a PPI before any money moves.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a black-over-grey GX470, seller-corrected to 2007, at 198,500 claimed miles, with a coherent, reputable mild build visible in photos: lift, matching BFG all-terrains, Method wheels and a roof basket. The seller gives a detailed mileage-stamped work list, including the timing belt, water pump and radiator at 179k. None of it is backed by a receipt, date or VIN, so the most important GX item remains claimed only. Observed issues are minor: yellowed headlight lenses, and a 2008 header against the seller's 2007 statement. Open questions are title, accident detail ('no major accidents'), how the lift treated the rear air suspension, warning lights, underside condition, transfer-case and transmission service, and tire dates. The $14,000 ask sits at the $13,837 fair-value mid, and the build is unlikely to command a premium on resale.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, the 179k timing-belt/water-pump/radiator invoice, and confirmation of whether the rear air suspension was converted to coils, and ask whether a PPI near Corona can be done before payment.
